description: Returns ONE passage of a book as an interlinear: the original text, a word-by-word table (each word, its transliteration, its everyday meaning, its literal sense where that differs, and its dictionary form), the flowing English, the editors' note, a citation string, and links to read it in the reader. Optionally adds the immediately following or preceding passage (never more than two passages per call; whole chapters or books are not available, by design). Refs look like "1.1" (Odyssey book 1 line 1), "17a" (Plato, Apology, Stephanus page), "1.1" (John 1:1), "77" (Gospel of Thomas, saying 77). When quoting, include the citation and the reader link.

book.description: Book title or slug, e.g. "Odyssey", "Apology", "John", "Gospel of Thomas". See list_books.

neighbor.description: Also return the passage right after or right before this one. Default none.

ref.description: Passage reference within the book, e.g. "1.1", "17a", "77".

name: get_passage
title: Read one passage word by word
